title: Agent command registry: full MCP tool surface over the editor
description: Depends on 0613-agent-bridge-mvp-protocol-package-vite-ws-relay-. Implement the full MVP tool surface from docs/19-agent-interface.md §Tool surface in packages/authoring-ui/src/agent/registry.ts, with zod param/result schemas in @flash/agent-protocol and one MCP tool registered per command in vite-plugin-agent-mcp (names are domain_action, e.g. stage_add_shape). Domains: document (doc_load, doc_set_properties, history_undo/redo/depth), stage & selection (stage_add_shape/add_text/place_instance/update/remove/arrange/group/ungroup, selection_get/set, view_set, tool_select), timeline (layer CRUD, insert_frame/insert_keyframe/insert_blank_keyframe/remove_frame, set_frame_label, set_tween, goto_frame, playback_play/stop), code (script_get/set/check/list — script_set runs compileScript in check mode and returns diagnostics without blocking the write), library (library_list/create_symbol/convert_to_symbol/rename/remove), output & escape hatches (jsfl_run, stage_screenshot returning an MCP image content block, publish_swf, file_save_fla/load_fla via in-memory FileIO). Also add the remaining MCP resources: flash://document, flash://library, flash://scripts. Rules: every handler goes through the shared command layer (@flash/core mutations + pushDoc + Shell selection/view setters) — never bypass history. Colors are #RRGGBB(AA) strings at the boundary; frame indices 0-based; mutating results include rev; tool errors use MCP isError with text that names the bad param and includes valid alternatives (e.g. known layerIds). Extract the Shell's __flashTest closures into a shared module so the test bridge and the registry share one implementation per command and cannot drift. Tests: unit tests per tool group against @flash/core fixtures + extend the e2e MCP spec to cover at least one mutate→doc_get assert round-trip per domain.
